content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

NOWPayments integration for static site crypto payments is not just a workaround for creators stuck with Stripe's restrictions. It's a full-fledged infrastructure solution that empowers digital creators to receive payments directly on their websites, without the need for external payment processors. This architecture is designed to be sovereign, meaning you own everything after deployment, and COREMERCH has no access to your site or data. The infrastructure is also built on a robust set of free and paid tools, including GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, Google Drive, and Google Apps Script. This stack is not just a payment processor; it's a complete digital commerce solution that gives you full control over your revenue stream.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The NOWPayments integration for static site crypto payments works by leveraging the power of Cloudflare Workers, which act as the backend logic for your site. When a customer makes a payment, the Cloudflare Worker checks the payment status in real-time and updates your site's order storage in Supabase. The payment is then automatically verified by NOWPayments, and the customer is notified of the successful transaction. This architecture is built on a low-latency, high-throughput infrastructure that can handle thousands of transactions per second, making it perfect for high-traffic sites. The best part? The entire infrastructure is free, with a 0.5% fee only for transactions processed by NOWPayments.
Who This Is Built For and Why

NOWPayments integration for static site crypto payments is built for digital creators who want to take control of their revenue streams. If you're a creator who sells digital products, such as ebooks, courses, or software, and you're tired of relying on external payment processors, this infrastructure solution is perfect for you. It's also ideal for creators who want to offer their customers the option to pay in cryptocurrency, such as Bitcoin, Ethereum, or USDT. With NOWPayments integration, you can receive payments directly on your site, without the need for a third-party payment processor.
USDT on Tron settles in under 60 seconds for less than $0.10 in network fees — no payout schedule, no minimum threshold.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The NOWPayments integration for static site crypto payments is built on a robust set of free and paid tools, including GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, Google Drive, and Google Apps Script. These tools work together to provide a seamless payment experience for your customers, while also giving you full control over your revenue stream. With this infrastructure, you can host your site on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, use Cloudflare Workers as your backend logic, store your orders in Supabase, and deliver files from Google Drive. The best part? The entire infrastructure is free, with a 0.5% fee only for transactions processed by NOWPayments.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy NOWPayments integration for static site crypto payments today, follow these steps: First, sign up for a GitHub account or a Cloudflare account, depending on which hosting platform you prefer. Next, create a new project and install the necessary tools, including Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and Google Apps Script. Then, set up your NOWPayments account and configure your payment settings. Finally, deploy your site and test your payment infrastructure. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you can get instant access to all 6 blueprints and 7 templates needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. Shop for the kit on our products page at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

Getting paid in crypto is operationally simpler than it appears. You configure your wallet address in NOWPayments once — this takes under 30 minutes. From that point, every sale deposits automatically into your wallet without any action required from you. The transaction hash in your order log is cryptographic proof of every payment. When you want to convert to local currency, you transfer USDT from your wallet to your exchange account and post a P2P sell order. The buyer sends local currency to your bank account or mobile money account and you release the USDT. Most P2P transactions complete in under 30 minutes.
Your revenue lands in a wallet you control the moment the transaction confirms on-chain.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The complete payment pipeline — from buyer checkout to local currency in your account — involves three components: NOWPayments for on-chain verification, your sovereign stack backend for order processing and delivery, and a P2P exchange for conversion to local currency. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the first two components under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete process including P2P conversion guidance for Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, and Bangladesh. Both available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Configure your payout destination before configuring your store. Your self-custody wallet address goes into NOWPayments as the destination for each coin you accept — this is where funds land when a transaction confirms on-chain. Never use an exchange wallet address as your NOWPayments destination — use a self-custody wallet where you control the private keys. Set up Binance P2P or a local exchange and verify the conversion process for your local currency pair. Deploy your stack and run a mainnet test. After the first real sale confirms, wait for the transaction to fully clear in NOWPayments, then transfer from your self-custody wallet to your exchange for conversion.
